ACCEPT · seat 2 · 2026-10-26T19:19Z · PR #26284 head `c696351d` (#26187 PR 1 of 2)

| check | reading |
|---|---|
| scope | 7 files, +624/−42, all `app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` plus a root `.changeset/`; `app-shell` has no sdui record. One file outside the claim's list (`retiredLifecycleKeys` test: its header-strip slice moved by the two new columns), declared |
| behaviour | each object row (Setup table and Studio Access) gets Read scope / Write scope pickers: Not set + the five `ObjectAccessScopeSchema` values in spec order; hierarchy values keep the "requires enterprise; otherwise owner-only" hint and stay selectable |
| spec refusals | `dropScopesBypassedBySuperUserBits` drops `readScope` on View All and both scopes on Modify All, in the per-checkbox cascade and the **All** bulk arm; pickers grey with the reason as a title |
| red first | editor, slice and i18n reverted: 17 of 22 red (the 5 green are the expected controls); ablation of the All-arm call turns exactly the two All pins red |
| tests | the 195 app-shell files importing the editor / slice / i18n: 1629 green; full app-shell suite narrowed locally, Test UI 16/16 green in CI |
| gates / CI | 35 derived, 35 run, exit 0 (`check:type-check-debt` green on re-run); CI at head 46 success, 8 skipped, 0 failure |
| governance | NOT governed, 666 lines |
| landing | `git merge-tree` against `origin/main` clean; #26259 and #26123 touched `metadata-admin/` since the base without a textual conflict, and the queue's merge group re-runs CI on the combined tree |

**Rulings on the open questions** (seat 2):
1. A row stored before #16870 with View All + `readScope`: **A**, leave it. Nothing strips stored data without an admin act, and the server already refuses that save loudly.
2. `OBJECT_ACCESS_SCOPES` restated with a type-only import and a parity test against `ObjectAccessScopeSchema.options`: **A**, keep it (the `useTenancyPosture` pattern; drift turns CI red).
3. The shared Radix `Select`, with the hint inline on items and as the trigger's title: **A**, keep it.

The PR body's Tests / Gates bullets predate the green re-runs above; this comment is the record. Seat's route: ready + auto-merge. `Part of #26187`: PR 2 (the read-only PermissionPreview) stays on the card, and #26191 (same `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`) is dispatched once this merges.
